title: Mira and the Mended Kite
summary: Mira and Pip repair a torn kite by calmly asking a neighbor for help.
lesson: Asking for help can be brave.

scenes.narration: Pip's paper tail tore in the breeze, and Mira stopped to listen before making a plan.
scenes.on_screen_text: Stop, listen, and make a plan
scenes.image_prompt: original child inventor and friendly paper kite in a sunny garden
